text:
Maya Patel: Quick design sync — thinking about the playground schema editor + run history UX for tool-calling. Wanted to float a few micro-copy and a11y ideas.
Ethan Chen: SG — what parts are you looking at specifically? schema editor, defs, or history UI?
Maya Patel: All three, but starting w/ schema editor. Current label says "Add function schema" which is vague. Suggest "Define tool inputs (JSON Schema)" to make it clearer for engineers and screen readers.
Samira Gupta: +1 on clarity. Also users keep asking where examples live. Can we add a small "Examples" toggle next to the label? collapsible so it doesn't clutter.
Clara Reyes: Accessibility nit: the toggle needs aria-expanded and a visible focus ring. Also ensure the example code blocks get aria-labels like "Example: function schema for address lookup".
Ethan Chen: Implementation note: examples are pulled from the model metadata. Adding a toggle is cheap. For aria labels we can inject "aria-label" into the pre blocks, but need to confirm content won't be too verbose for screen readers.
Maya Patel: Good call. For copy in the run history we have "View invocation" vs "Open run" — ambiguity there. Propose "View invocation details" and a secondary action "Re-run with same inputs".
Samira Gupta: Users asked for keyboard-first flows when debugging. Could we support a focused-run keyboard shortcut (e.g., press "r" when a run is selected) and a visible tooltip? Prod question for Ethan.
Ethan Chen: We can add a `data-run-id` attr and a key handler in the history list. Need to check conflicts w/ browser shortcuts. Tooltip is easy. Will file a small eng task.
Clara Reyes: Also ensure the run list has role=list and each item role=listitem; add aria-selected for keyboard navigation. Screen reader users should hear "Selected run, status: succeeded, duration: 320ms".
Maya Patel: For function defs UI: when a dev toggles "required" fields, the editor currently reflows a lot. Proposal: inline pill for required fields and a hover explanation "Field required at runtime" to avoid layout jumps.
Ethan Chen: Reflow issue caused by label wrapping. We can set min-width on the field header and use CSS to keep layout stable. Inline pill sounds fine.
Samira Gupta: UX question: should the schema preview update live with edits or be behind a "Preview" button? Live preview is helpful but can be noisy for larger schemas.
Maya Patel: Leaning live but debounce 600ms and collapse large diffs behind a "Show full JSON diff" link.
Clara Reyes: For diffs: use semantic announcements for screen readers when diff appears: "Schema preview updated — 4 changes". Avoid auto-scrolling that breaks keyboard focus.
DevEx Bot: deploy.preview: playground-schema-a11y-patch deployed to staging at 2026-03-23T14:22Z :rocket:
Ethan Chen: Nice. I'll add aria-* to the preview and the examples toggle in the same PR. Will also add keyboard handler and an opt-in in user prefs for "live preview".
Maya Patel: Thanks — can you include the exact copy strings in the PR description? e.g., "Define tool inputs (JSON Schema)", "Examples", "View invocation details", "Re-run with same inputs" and the tooltip "Field required at runtime".
Samira Gupta: I'll draft a short help blurb for the docs referencing the keyboard shortcut and preview behavior.
Clara Reyes: I'll review the staging build with VoiceOver and NVDA tomorrow morning.
Maya Patel: Perfect — feel free to @me on the PR and I’ll sign off on the copy. :thumbsup:
Ethan Chen: Will do. Thanks everyone.
